hooks.command: dir=.claude/backlog/tasks; if [ -d "$dir" ]; then open=$(grep -l '^status: open' "$dir"/*.md 2>/dev/null | wc -l | tr -d ' '); prog=$(grep -l '^status: in-progress' "$dir"/*.md 2>/dev/null | wc -l | tr -d ' '); blocked=$(grep -l '^status: blocked' "$dir"/*.md 2>/dev/null | wc -l | tr -d ' '); if [ "$open" != "0" ] || [ "$prog" != "0" ] || [ "$blocked" != "0" ]; then echo "Backlog: $open open, $prog in-progress, $blocked blocked. Say 'next task' or '/backlog:list' to see them."; fi; fi
